universal_patterns.pattern: any (?:occupational or professional )?certificate, permit, or license issued

proposal.rationale: North Dakota's Title 43 is Occupations and Professions. Chapters within Title 43 are written as "Chapter 43-NN" or "Chapter 43-NN.N" (e.g., 43-50, 43-51.1), and sections look like "43-50-01" where the middle token "50" identifies the chapter. Chapter 43-50 (Occupational Licensee Database) opens with "For purposes of this chapter" and applies to any issuer/holder of an occupational or professional certificate, permit, or license — a universal chapter-wide signal. Chapter 43-51.1 (Universal Licensure) uses "As used in this chapter" (handled by the cross-state AS_USED_RE walker). The trigger patterns cover the standard "licensed under/pursuant to/to practice" enumerations that appear in ND practice-act cross-references. Slug prefix is "chapter" matching Justia's ND chapter slugs like "chapter-43-50".
